title: ApprovalPolicy
description:
Closed local approval policy for tool calls (config spec C-1).

The policy only decides whether the agent asks the user before running a tool. It can never auto-approve a tool whose `ToolSpec.requires_approval` is true (weak invariant T1); the only exception is the per-conversation always-allow set owned by the approval spec (S4), which is an explicit earlier user authorization, not a policy decision.

oneOf.description: Ask exactly for tools that declare `requires_approval` (default).
Read-only tools run without asking; every mutating tool asks.
Ask for every tool call, including read-only ones (strictest).
